name: The International Linear Collider Technical Design Report - Volume 1: Executive Summary

summary.plain: The executive summary of the ILC Technical Design Report; it names two candidate sites for the machine in Asia.
summary.technical: ILC TDR vol. 1 (arXiv:1306.6327): four-volume TDR for a 500 GeV superconducting-RF linear collider; identifies two possible ILC candidate sites, Kitakami in the Tohoku district and Sefuri in the Kyushu district.
